decisions.reason: Although a schlager compilation CD uses the firm's physical-release know-how, its non-observation after 2019 suggests this genre extension did not create enough durable, learnable demand within the firm's specialist model to merit continued support.

An illustrated music release series is closely related to the firm's curation and edition-making capabilities and, as a multi-model line, offers management more scope to absorb feedback and refine the format rather than exit quickly.
A reissued jazz vinyl LP fits the firm's core reissue competence, collector audience, and genre-broadening path, so absorptive capacity favors continued commercialization and incremental learning.

A multi-disc box set is more demanding in inventory and production terms, but it remains strongly aligned with the firm's established label and collector-edition strengths, making retention more likely than withdrawal.

Even though a compilation CD is close to the firm's existing offer, this item appears less distinctive and less deeply embedded than its stronger reissue formats, so management would likely redeploy resources if traction has remained limited.
